This mod replaces several items so the player can have their very own game room and a few other items.

It replaces the modern dining table, stone slab, red rug, manicured pine, small plant, table plant with a pool table, Saloon's arcade machines, bear rug, grandfather clock, Shane's game console, and Abigail's game console. In that order.
